title: Design System: SIC 2027 — Hyderabad Sports Injuries Conclave

fjord.purpose: Hairline borders at 0.3-0.5 alpha; gradient partner.

gold.purpose: The only accent. 10.8:1 on navy and on ink; ~2:1 on white, so never ink on a light ground.

gold-display.purpose: Primary-pill hover on dark; display type at 24pt+ on white (3.25:1).

gold-ink.purpose: Gold body text and small labels on white paper (6.4:1).

saffron.purpose: Provisional-state signal only: flight captions, draft strips, draft marks. Not a second accent.

mist.purpose: Secondary text on the poster's navy ground (8.9:1).

mute.purpose: Secondary text on dark grounds site-wide (9.3:1 on navy).

silver.purpose: Hairline rules on light print pages.

poster.purpose: Save-the-date scale only — 258px date numerals, 98px conclave name. Tracking goes to zero or negative.

headline.purpose: Page and hero H1, one per page.

title.purpose: Mission quotes and pull statements set in Bebas as a block.

body.purpose: All running prose. Measure held by the 76rem container and 52-62rem max-widths.

label.purpose: Table headers, form labels, meta rows, breadcrumbs. Gold on dark, ink-safe gold on light.

shadows.name: gold-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary pill on hover, fine pointers only.

shadows.name: band-lift
shadows.purpose: The countdown slab; the inset top highlight is what makes it read as a slab.

shadows.name: band-lift-focus
shadows.purpose: Countdown band at its emphasised breakpoint.

shadows.name: floating-panel
shadows.purpose: Mobile nav sheet — the one element genuinely above the page.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state changes and entrances; the built-in easings read as unintentional.

motion.name: slash-angle
motion.purpose: The gold slash motif's rotation on the hero; print uses skewY(-2deg).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition-property: opacity, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, outline-color; duration 150ms
motion.purpose: Reduced motion means gentler, not zero — movement is dropped, fades are kept.

canvases.name: save-the-date
canvases.purpose: WhatsApp and email circulation; judged first at ~240px wide.

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: The one call to action; gold fill, black text, fully rounded.

narrative.overview:
Everything in this identity happens on a dark ground, and one warm light picks out the thing that matters. The ground is navy, nearly black at the top of the stack and never neutral grey; the light is a single gold. Nothing else glows. That is the whole system, and every surface — the website, the printed brochure, the badge, the save-the-date sheet — is a different distance from the same floodlit field.

The density is editorial rather than brochure-like: large uppercase Bebas Neue carrying names, numbers and dates, and Archivo doing all the actual talking underneath it in small, widely-tracked lines. Surfaces are built from hairline borders over tinted navy, not from drop shadows; depth comes from tone and from a 1px edge, and movement is short and firm (120ms press, 200ms state change) rather than bouncy. Photography is real — athletes, not illustration. The organiser has rejected AI-generated decorative artwork for this project and that rejection is binding on every future surface.

The one tension the system carries deliberately: the website leans dense (numbered sections, stat cards, chips, a countdown band), while circulating material leans austere. The 2027 save-the-date resolves that tension by stripping the panel vocabulary out entirely. Both are the same world; they differ in how much of it is spoken aloud.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground always; light grounds exist only in print and switch the gold.
Exactly one accent, used sparingly enough that it still reads as a signal.
Bebas shouts, Archivo speaks; neither does the other's job.
Hairline borders on tinted navy instead of elevation.
Built to be inherited: swap the year, the system still holds.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: There is one accent on any surface, and it marks the single thing the reader must leave with. On the save-the-date that is the date — gold appears on the numerals, on the year in the title, and on the 3px edge that splits the sheet, and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Ink-Safe Gold Rule
rules.body: #FCA311 on white measures about 2:1 and is never used for text on a light ground. Small text and labels on white take #8A5200; display type at 24pt or larger may take #C77F08. Full gold on white is permitted only as a fill (a rule, a band, a border), never as ink.

rules.name: The Saffron Is A Warning Rule
rules.body: #FDD400 means provisional. If a surface is final, it has no saffron on it.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bebas carries names, numbers, dates and single-line shouts. Archivo carries anything that is a sentence. A paragraph never goes in Bebas, and a date never goes in Archivo.

rules.name: The Inverse Tracking Rule
rules.body: Tracking moves opposite to size. Small uppercase Archivo takes 0.14-0.24em; Bebas at display scale takes 0.02-0.03em; Bebas at poster scale takes 0 to -0.01em. Uniform tracking across the ramp is a defect.

rules.name: The Thumbnail Test
rules.body: Anything that circulates is judged at roughly 240px wide in a chat list before it is judged at full size. If the name and the date are not readable there, the composition is wrong — not the font size.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: To raise a surface, change its tone and give it a 1px fjord hairline. Reach for a shadow only when the element is responding to the pointer or is literally overlaying the page.

rules.name: The Four Radii Rule
rules.body: 10px controls, 14px cards, 99px pills, 50% circles. A new radius value is a design decision, not a tweak.

rules.name: The Edge-Not-Box Departure
rules.body: The save-the-date drops the card and panel vocabulary entirely: zero radius, no borders, no shadows, nothing floating — two fields split by a single 3px gold edge. This is a deliberate departure for circulating artefacts, where panel chrome reads as clutter at thumbnail size. It does not retire the site's panel language, and it does not license removing borders from site cards.

dos: Do keep one accent per surface, and spend it on the single thing the reader must remember.
Do use #8A5200 for gold text on white and #C77F08 only at 24pt or larger; full #FCA311 on white is a fill, never ink.
Do build raised surfaces from navy plus a 1px fjord hairline, and save shadow for hover and genuinely floating elements.
Do gate every hover state behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
Do keep reduced-motion gentle: drop movement, keep colour and opacity fades.
Do animate translate / scale as independent properties, not transform.
Do check any circulating artefact at roughly 240px wide before calling it finished.
Do keep the year as the gold element in the lockup, so a new edition inherits the identity by changing one number.
donts: Don't introduce a third hue. Saffron is a provisional-state signal, not a second accent, and nothing else enters the palette.
Don't set running prose in Bebas Neue, or a date in Archivo.
Don't apply uniform letter-spacing across the type ramp — tracking falls as size rises.
Don't add a radius value outside 10px / 14px / 99px / 50%.
Don't put a resting shadow on a card.
Don't reintroduce AI-generated decorative artwork; the organiser rejected it for this project and real photography is the standing answer.
Don't carry the save-the-date's borderless, radius-zero treatment back into site components — it is a departure scoped to circulating artefacts.
